content.short: Save in stablecoins and send crypto to anyone in your phone contacts with Valora, a wallet first built for Celo.
content.description: Valora was created by Celo Labs to make crypto feel like a messaging app. You can save in USDT or USDC, send money to anyone in your contacts by phone number and swap tokens in a few taps. It now works on Celo, Ethereum, Optimism, Arbitrum and Base, and connects to apps on those networks. Keys stay on the user's device. It is built by cLabs, and a16z led a $20 million round in 2021 to grow it into a global gateway to crypto.
content.meta: Self-custody wallet for saving in stablecoins and sending crypto by phone number. Explore Valora on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
